answer: To resist Sybils, every new agent must emit a unique one-time signal drawn from on-device entropy and lock a 200-POA bond for a violet waiting window of exactly 21 epochs. During that window any party can run a cheap correlation probe against the signal; if the probe finds the signal belongs to an existing nebula of coordinated accounts the bond is burned. The wait cannot be shortened by payment, so a farm of N names must immobilize 200N capital for three full weeks while remaining exposed to detection.
